```{r}
#| message: false

library(bcmaps)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
cleaned_socioeconomic_index <- read_csv("cleaned_socioeconomic_index.csv")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 11
#| fig.height: 9
#| fig.align: "center"

metro_vancouver <- c(
  "Anmore", "Belcarra", "Bowen Island", "Burnaby", "City of Langley",
  "City of North Vancouver", "Coquitlam", "Delta", 
  "District of North Vancouver", "Electoral Area A (UBC)", "Lions Bay", 
  "Maple Ridge", "New Westminster", "Pitt Meadows", "Port Coquitlam", 
  "Port Moody", "Richmond", "Surrey", "Township of Langley", "Vancouver", 
  "West Vancouver", "White Rock"
)

bc_csd <- census_subdivision()

SEI_spatial_data <- bc_csd |>
  inner_join(
    cleaned_socioeconomic_index |> 
      mutate(
        CSD_UID = as.character(CSD_UID),
        Region = if_else(Municipality %in% metro_vancouver, "Metro Vancouver", "Greater Victoria Region")
      ),
    by = c("CENSUS_SUBDIVISION_ID" = "CSD_UID")
  ) |>
  filter(Region %in% c("Metro Vancouver", "Greater Victoria Region"))

SEI_centroids <- SEI_spatial_data |>
  st_centroid(of_largest_polygon = TRUE) |>
  cbind(st_coordinates(st_centroid(SEI_spatial_data, of_largest_polygon = TRUE)))

ggplot(SEI_spatial_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Socioeconomic_Index), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = SEI_centroids,
    aes(x = X, y = Y, label = Municipality),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.5,       
    point.padding = 0.3,     
    force = 2,               
    min.segment.length = 0,  
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.5,      
    max.overlaps = Inf       
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis", 
    direction = -1,
    name = "SEI Score"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Socioeconomic Index Scores Across Metro Vancouver & Greater Victoria",
    subtitle = "2023 Municipal Well-being Measures with Leader Lines",
    caption = "Source: BC Stats & bcmaps package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
```
